name: How do you properly cover water stains on a ceiling before painting?

mainEntity.name: How do you properly cover water stains on a ceiling before painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Water stains cannot be hidden with standard paint alone; they will bleed through multiple coats of standard latex. The first step is verifying that the source of the leak—such as roof damage or upper-floor plumbing—is completely fixed and the drywall has dried. Next, scrape any flaking material, patch the drywall as needed, and seal the area with a stain-blocking primer, such as an oil-based or shellac-based formula. Once cured, apply two coats of ceiling paint over the entire expanse to ensure a seamless sheen without visible spot patches.
acceptedAnswer.description: Fix the leak, repair damaged drywall, seal the spot with a stain-blocking primer, and paint the entire ceiling so the repair blends seamlessly.
